name: android_get_logcat
description: Returns the newest logcat lines (limit, default 50), optionally only one tag and only from a minimum level up (V, D, I, W, E, F). With crashesOnly: true, returns crash traces and ANRs from the crash buffer instead, optionally for one package.

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.

crashesOnly.description: Crash buffer only: crashes and ANRs (default false).

limit.description: Maximum number of log lines to retrieve (default 50).
